subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Analisar e avaliar os impasses ético-políticos decorrentes das transformações culturais, sociais, históricas, científicas e tecnológicas no mundo contemporâneo e seus desdobramentos nas atitudes e nos valores de indivíduos, grupos sociais, sociedades e culturas.

components.description_pt: Identificar dilemas ético-políticos decorrentes de transformações culturais, científicas e tecnológicas contemporâneas
components.description_en: Identify ethical-political dilemmas arising from contemporary cultural, scientific, and technological transformations
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate accepted scientific explanations against new evidence, limitations, constraints, and ethical issues

components.description_pt: Analisar como transformações tecnológicas e sociais afetam valores de indivíduos e grupos
components.description_en: Analyze how technological and social transformations affect the values of individuals and groups
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a foundational American literary work reflects the values or concerns of its historical period

components.description_pt: Avaliar dilemas ético-políticos e suas consequências para atitudes e comportamentos sociais
components.description_en: Evaluate ethical-political dilemmas and their consequences for social attitudes and behaviors
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate probable causes and consequences of social situations through dialogue

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret scientific arguments by
* Identifying __appropriate and sufficient__ evidence from data, models, and/ or information from investigations of a phenomenon or design solutions
* Comparing reasoning and claims based on evidence __from competing arguments or design solutions__
* Evaluating __currently accepted explanations, new evidence, limitations (trade-offs), constraints, and ethical issues__

Demonstrate knowledge of eighteenth-, nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century foundational works of American literature, including how two or more texts from the same period treat similar themes or topics.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interactuar con otros (personas y medios) sobre explicaciones para...
* entender situaciones o eventos desde diferentes puntos de vista
* ponerse de acuerdo sobre componentes, orden, causas y consecuencias o ciclos utilizando ejemplos y detalles relevantes
* evaluar causas y consecuencias probables de situaciones o eventos
* dialogar acerca de los factores o causas principales que contribuyen a eventos y acontecimientos
* comparar las opiniones en diferentes fuentes para resolver preguntas indispensables
